label: Surface water extent
aggregation: water share of known pixels x county area
notes: Water = MNDWI (B4 green vs B7 SWIR 2.1um) > 0.1 in >=50% of cloud-free 8-day composites in the month (Terra+Aqua). Captures open water and shallow inundation; some residual false positives from dark wet vegetation early in the wet season (Jun-Aug). Cloud gaps filled from previous month (max 2 months); county-months with <20% known area dropped. Detects open water; under-detects flooded/floating vegetation (Sudd) and is reduced by persistent wet-season cloud. Validation vs 30 UNOSAT VIIRS water-extent tables (HDX, 2022-10..2025-04, scripts/water_validate_unosat.py): state-level r = 0.76; MODIS totals ~0.5x UNOSAT (close in Jun-Sep, 2-5x lower in the dry season when UNOSAT counts vegetated swamp water). Treat as a conservative, relative flood signal.
source: MODIS MOD09A1 + MYD09A1 v061 8-day surface reflectance via Microsoft Planetary Computer
